title: Something Went Wrong on Tuesday
gist_ar: زميل بيحكي قصة إنذار الحريق، والدرس اللي خرج بيه في الآخر.

before_listening.en: A colleague tells you what happened at work on Tuesday. Listen for the LESSON he learned, not just the events.
before_listening.ar: زميل بيحكي لك إيه اللي حصل في الشغل يوم التلات. ركّز على الدرس اللي اتعلمه، مش الأحداث بس.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: So, you asked what happened on Tuesday. It was actually quite funny, although it did not feel funny at the time. I was sitting at my desk, finishing the monthly report, when the fire alarm went off. Everybody stood up, and we all walked down to the car park, the way we practised last year. While we were waiting outside, I realised that I was still holding my coffee, but I had left my laptop upstairs, unlocked, with the report open on the screen. I was thinking about running back up when the building manager told us it was a false alarm. Someone was making toast on the third floor. Anyway, when I got back to my desk, my laptop had gone to sleep and the report had not saved. I lost about forty minutes of work. So now I press save every five minutes, and I do not make toast at work.

gist_question.q: Why is he telling this story?
options: To complain about the building's fire alarm
To explain why he now saves his work constantly
To describe the fire drill they practised last year

questions.q: What was he doing when the alarm went off?
questions.q_ar: كان بيعمل إيه لما الإنذار رنّ؟

options: A real fire on the third floor
